name: NESIT
summary: A technology-focused 501(c)(3) hackerspace in Meriden, strong in electronics, digital fabrication and amateur radio.

operations.hours_note: Public open house Fridays 7–10pm — tours and meeting members.

sources.note: Superseded Google Site, recovered 2026-08-28 from its still-live sites.google.com address. Street address, website and descriptive text are transcribed from it verbatim. The logo is the space's own mark, recovered from the same page.
'CT Makerspaces Map' My Map attached to the superseded site. Coordinates are the 'NESIT Makerspace' pin, transcribed from its KML, not geocoded.

Own site: Fridays 7–10pm are member nights open to the public. Equipment named includes 3D printers (Prusa i3 MK3), two 60W Epilog laser cutters, CNC, woodworking, metalworking, electronics benches and leatherworking.

gaps: address and coordinates come from the superseded Google Site and its map; neither has been confirmed with the space
capabilities are inferred from prose on the superseded Google Site and are not confirmed
membership prices and member access hours are not published on their site
